args.prompt: Create EXACTLY FOUR NEW COMPLETE full-body pixel-art drawings of Nick from Left4Dead2 (2009), FOUR equal columns by ONE row, transparent RGBA. This is a native correction of the attached accepted source: its last super row touches the lower canvas and cuts the brown shoe soles. Keep Nick's character and outfit identical, but REDRAW FOUR complete anatomical poses with at least 12% EMPTY TRANSPARENT SPACE below BOTH shoes in EVERY cell and generous clear separation between columns. Adult lean white man, swept-back dark hair, slight stubble, WHITE business suit and white trousers, open royal BLUE shirt, dark belt, BROWN leather shoes. Actual equipment only: one black P220-style semi-automatic pistol plus a shorter black Glock-style offhand pistol, BOTH physical hand-held guns with plausible separate hands/grips. Face right three-quarter side view. Super is Double pistolet de Nick, a physical dual-pistol salvo adapted to one engine impact, not laser/magic. Column0: complete standing preparation, knees naturally bent, both pistols lowered near hips. Column1: step into a wider planted stance, lift both forearms to aim two separate pistols forward at chest height, fingers/grips physically connected, no discharge. Column2: visibly different forward recoil stance, shoulders and knees reacting, both physical pistols aimed forward with only a SMALL LOCAL yellow-orange muzzle flash on each barrel, no long projectile or painted target. Column3: relax out of the recoil, straighten torso and lower both pistols near the hips, distinct from column0. Four genuinely distinct native drawings of the same body/props; do not copy or mirror one pose. Keep natural stance/body size differences, consistent source anatomical density; all head, hair, coat tails, fingers, gun barrels, shoe soles and shadowless outlines fully INSIDE the transparent image with LARGE transparent margins. NO source-row clipping, NO filled background, floor, cast shadow, lettering, UI, watermark, extra humans, gore or new powers. Use the attached image only as appearance reference; supply this ONE complete corrected super row.
